data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 034b515562bf66237e18e5327f4ef449eb43cd8a (origin/main, post-PR-#352 merge — i.e., post 5be7 fix)
* **Workflow:** .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml (Reconcile Bridge) — workflow_dispatch with mode=dry-run
* **Failed run:** https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26422283057
* **JIRA_PROJECT:** DIG
* **BRIDGE_ENV_ID:** 87bd1065-0264-4126-94b7-ae8c71b8d506

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Live-environment surface (epic 4047 VALIDATION-CLASS verification, second-order surface revealed by fix to bug 5be7-d657-1dde-4237)

#### Expected Behavior

After bug 5be7 was fixed (repo_root now defaults to the project root when --repo-root is omitted), the guard sequence in __main__.main() should:
1. Mode.from_str — validate `dry-run` ✓ (passed)
2. check_pass_lock — read .reconciler-pass-lock from tickets branch ✓ (passed: returned False, no lock present)
3. check_phase_gate — read .reconciler-phase-gate from tickets branch ✓ (passed: returned False, no gate present)
4. acquire_pass_lock — write .reconciler-pass-lock to tickets branch ← FAILS

`acquire_pass_lock` uses `git worktree add /tmp/advisory-lock-wt-parent-XXX/wt tickets` to materialise the tickets branch into a temporary worktree, then commits the lock file inside that worktree via `_concurrency.rebase_retry` (the same pattern used by mid-pass tickets-tracker writes elsewhere in the reconciler). For this to succeed, the local refs database must contain `tickets` as a fetchable branch.

#### Actual Behavior

`acquire_pass_lock` fails at line 168 of `_advisory_lock.py` with:

```
ReconcileLockError: acquire_pass_lock failed for pass_id='2026-05-25T22-30-06':
  abort_due_to_error: Command '['git', '-C', '/home/runner/work/digital-service-orchestra/digital-service-orchestra',
  'worktree', 'add', '/tmp/advisory-lock-wt-parent-8pr74c_f/wt', 'tickets']' returned non-zero exit status 128.
```

Git exit 128 here is `fatal: invalid reference: tickets`. The CI runner's checkout step uses `actions/checkout@v4 with fetch-depth: 1`, which fetches only the head of the default branch (`main`). The `tickets` orphan branch is never fetched into the local refs, so `git worktree add ... tickets` cannot resolve it.

Read-side operations (`check_pass_lock`, `check_phase_gate`) use `git show tickets:<file>` which handles missing refs differently (the script's existing fail-CLOSED path treats missing tickets branch as a ReconcileLockError per the f516 design). But on a CI checkout with `fetch-depth: 1`, the read-side operations apparently DID succeed in this run — likely because `git show tickets:.reconciler-pass-lock` returned "exists on disk but not in tickets" (i.e., the file is absent in tickets but the ref CAN be resolved as a remote-tracking ref). The asymmetry is that `git worktree add` cannot use `refs/remotes/origin/tickets` directly — it needs a local `tickets` ref. Without one, exit 128.

(Why did the earlier scheduled run on 2026-05-24 succeed against the older pre-5be7 codebase? Because the earlier reconciler code did not USE `git worktree add tickets` — it used a different concurrency pattern. The new acquire/release pattern in a2ba's _advisory_lock.py introduced the worktree-add dependency.)

### 3. Action History

* PR #345 (epic 4047) merged 2026-05-25T21:11:57Z — introduced the new advisory_lock acquire/release pattern.
* PR #352 (bug 5be7) merged 2026-05-25T22:24Z — fixed repo_root=None propagation.
* Triggered `gh workflow run "Reconcile Bridge" --field mode=dry-run` 2026-05-25T22:29Z.
* Run https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26422283057 progressed past check_pass_lock + check_phase_gate (proving the 5be7 fix worked) but failed at acquire_pass_lock with the worktree-add-tickets exit 128.

### 4. Suspected Categories

* **Same test-stub blind-spot pattern as 5be7:** test_advisory_lock.py exercises check_pass_lock / check_phase_gate / acquire_pass_lock / release_pass_lock via in-process unit tests that set up a local tickets branch in tmp_path. The CI execution environment, however, has a `fetch-depth: 1` checkout with NO tickets branch locally. The full real-git path with a tickets-less checkout is unexercised by any test.
* **Workflow vs. code-level fix tradeoff:**
  - **Workflow fix:** change `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml` checkout step to fetch the tickets branch — e.g., add a step `git fetch origin tickets:tickets` after the actions/checkout. Simple, localised, but requires every consumer of the reconciler workflow to apply the same change (no other consumers today, but the pattern proliferates).
  - **Code-level fix:** in `acquire_pass_lock` (and `release_pass_lock`, and any other operation that needs the tickets branch locally), detect when the local `tickets` ref is absent and fetch it from `origin/tickets` first. More robust (the reconciler is now self-sufficient about its branch prerequisites) but touches the load-bearing _concurrency / rebase_retry pattern.
  - **Recommended: code-level.** The reconciler shipped as a self-contained orchestrator and should not depend on every consumer workflow remembering to fetch tickets explicitly.

### 5. Skills and Workflows Touched

* Workflow: `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml` (the failing job)
* Module: `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_advisory_lock.py` (acquire_pass_lock at line 168)
* Module: `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/_concurrency.py` (rebase_retry / worktree pattern that acquire_pass_lock uses)
* Test: `tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_advisory_lock.py` (7 tests, all set up a local tickets ref via tmp_path — none exercise the "fetch missing tickets first" path)

### 6. Logs and Evidence

* CI log: `gh run view 26422283057 --log-failed --job <id> | tail -60`
* Stack trace verbatim:
```
File ".../dso_reconciler/__main__.py", line 205, in main
    advisory.acquire_pass_lock(pass_id, repo_root)
File ".../dso_reconciler/_advisory_lock.py", line 168, in acquire_pass_lock
    raise ReconcileLockError(...)
ReconcileLockError: acquire_pass_lock failed for pass_id='2026-05-25T22-30-06':
  abort_due_to_error: Command ['git', '-C', '/home/runner/work/.../digital-service-orchestra',
    'worktree', 'add', '/tmp/advisory-lock-wt-parent-8pr74c_f/wt', 'tickets'] returned non-zero exit status 128.
```

#### Suggested fix

In `_advisory_lock.py`, wrap the `git worktree add tickets` invocation with a fetch-if-missing precondition:

```python
def _ensure_tickets_branch(repo_root: Path) -> None:
    rc = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "rev-parse", "--verify", "tickets"],
                       capture_output=True, check=False)
    if rc.returncode != 0:
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo_root), "fetch", "origin", "tickets:tickets"],
                      check=True)
```

Call it inside `acquire_pass_lock` and `release_pass_lock` before the worktree-add. Add a regression test that:
1. Creates a fresh tmp_path with no `tickets` branch.
2. Configures a remote (origin) that DOES have `tickets`.
3. Calls acquire_pass_lock → asserts success after the fetch.
4. Asserts the local `tickets` ref now exists.

This pattern is analogous to the f516 `repo_root` defaulting fix — pushing infrastructure assumptions inside the module rather than relying on every caller to set them up.

#### Pattern observation (same class as 5be7)

This is the SECOND bug surfaced by live verification in the same fix-bug session. Both follow the same anti-pattern: the test suite stubs the advisory_lock module's interaction with real git (mocking subprocess calls or using tmp_path with pre-populated refs), so production-only path defects (None propagation, missing tickets branch in checkout) never trigger a test failure. A higher-fidelity integration test that actually creates a fresh git repo without pre-populating the tickets branch and runs main() against it would catch BOTH 5be7 and this class. Filing as a follow-up: the test suite needs at least one "real-git integration" test per advisory_lock public function.

#### Blocks

Epic 4047-3cb1-6cb4-46a1 VALIDATION-CLASS evidence capture (continues to be blocked by the advisory_lock path; the dry-run pass still cannot complete).
data.title: dso_reconciler._advisory_lock.acquire_pass_lock: git worktree add tickets fails in CI when tickets branch not fetched locally
